text_block_list.text:
One day, I walk into my office to find
Fuji Kiseki
reading some fan letters.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's nothing like receiving a
handwritten
letter. It always brings me
pure joy to read my
fans' words of
support.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Ah, I remember the person who sent me
this. They
always give me such beautiful
bouquets after my
races.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
And this one's from... Oh, yes. One of my
most
passionate fans yet.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Let's see... "I was sitting on the left side
at your
last concert, but I felt like you
didn't look over as
often as you usually
do."
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hm... I must've been too caught up in my

performance and forgot to give the
audience
enough attention.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I must be more mindful of that bad
habit... I don't
want to disappoint my
dear supporters.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
But of course. I want each of them to
feel equally
appreciated and seen.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
If my goal was merely to amuse myself, I
wouldn't
go to such lengths, but that's
not the level of
entertainment I aim to
provide.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Now then! Time to reply to everyone!
Hm, what
should I write back? ♪
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки hums happily to herself as she
gazes at
all the letters before her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
